messages:
alex: FYI staging push for svc-bridge failed during manifest finalize. Deploybot: 'manifest split detected'.

deploybot: [automated] publish failed: interleaved chunk uploads detected across parallel writers — aborting publish.

maria: ugh. does that mean we have two different manifests for the same tag?

jordan: quick check: saw two distinct manifest digests in the registry for tag `staging-latest`. Canary traffic might hit either.

sam: we should pin staging to the last-good digest and rollback the canary until we republish. Avoid promoting to prod.

alex: last-good digest from last successful canary: `sha256:abcd1234ef567890`. I can kick a republish with single-writer mode.

infra-bot: started job `republish-staging-3123456795` (mode=single-writer). ETA ~5m.

maria: also placing a temporary promotion hold on the release window — no auto-promotes until we sign off provenance.

jordan: added a note in release notes: "staging publish failure: duplicate manifests observed, pining/rollback active." ops oncall cc @sam.

sam: fallback plan: if republish fails, pin CI/deploy pipelines to `sha256:abcd1234ef567890` and abort current release window. Also run `cosign verify` on the manifest list.

alex: logs snippet:
```
ERROR: manifest list entries mismatch: multiple configs for linux/amd64
upload id: 0a1b2c...
parallel-writer: true
retry disabled for single-writer mode
```

deploybot: manual command available: `/deploybot pin svc-bridge staging sha256:abcd1234ef567890` — requires release-approver role.

maria: executing the pin now.

maria: pinned svc-bridge@staging -> sha256:abcd1234ef567890 :white_check_mark:

jordan: initiating canary rollback to pinned digest.

infra-bot: canary rollback completed to sha256:abcd1234ef567890 at ts=3123456860.

sam: next steps: once republish job finishes, run a verification pass: `cosign verify --manifest <digest>` and `skopeo inspect --raw` compare against the pinned digest. If clean, do a staging-only dry-run promote, then lift the hold. Keep release window blocked for 30m.

alex: ack. I'm also going to add a lock in the CI publish job to prevent parallel writers (runner autoscale race).

maria: pinging security to do a provenance audit after republish.

jordan: thanks team — reconvene in 15m for status.

sam: note for postmortem: add checklist for parallel-publish detection and a fail-open vs fail-closed decision matrix for deploybot.
